MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING

BETWEEN:

<Client>

AND

Office of Operational Strategic Initiatives

University of California, San Diego

This Memorandum of Understanding (“MOU”) is made as of <long date>, 2017, by <client> (“<client acronym>”) and the Office of Operational Strategic Initiatives (“OSI”) at University of California, San Diego.

WHEREAS, <client acronym> seeks to acquire the services of OSI to partner in achieving <client acronym> goal to implement a culture of continuous improvement in <client acronym> operations and establish a continuous improvement program that integrates with other <client acronym> services, processes, and projects/programs.

NOW, THEREFORE, the parties agree as follows.

OFFICE OF OPERATIONAL STRATEGIC INITIATIVES SERVICES INCLUDE:

TRAINING

Courier Simulation Yellow Belt Training Workshops will be executed in <start date/month> through May 2017, with the objective of training <end date/month> team members in Lean Six Sigma tools and methodology.  The facilitated sessions for groups of 16-20 or 32-40 include the following related services:

Tailoring of Rath and Strong Courier Simulation™ content and design to be more relevant to a UC San Diego audience.

Facilitation of participants by certified Lean Six Sigma Black Belts and Green Belts.

Ordering and coordination of relevant supplies, materials, facilities, equipment, and food for participants related to the trainings.

Electronic copy of PowerPoint slides to be posted on <client acronym> intranet (not for replication and distribution) for participants who have completed the training.

ilities, equipment, and food for participants related to the trainings.

Electronic copy of PowerPoint slides to be posted on <client acronym> intranet (not for replication and distribution) for participants who have completed the training.

TERM

The term of this MOU is through <end date/month>.

CONSIDERATION

The service fee for OSI services to be rendered to <client acronym> assumes that any significant changes to the services outlined above would require mutual agreement from both parties.  The service fee (“Fee”) shall equal the following.

PRICING

Attendee Courier Simulation/Yellow Belt Training Workshops on <training dates>:

$1,000.00 for up to 20 participants

$1,500.00 for up to 40 participants

This pricing does not apply to open-enrollment classes provided by OSI

NOTICES AND PAYMENTS

Payments will be process via Recharge. Any notice shall be deemed delivered five (5) days after invoice is mailed, or, if personally delivered or electronically mailed, when acknowledgement of receipt is signed or an electronic receipt is received, as provided above.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties hereto have executed this MOU on the dates specified below.
